english.title: Sell corrosive product to person under 18 years of age
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sold to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person under the age of 18 years, a corrosive product, namely **(..SPECIFY CORROSIVE PRODUCT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) and (7)(a) of the Offensive Weapons Act 2019.

english.notes:
(i) 'Corrosive product' applies to the substances listed in Schedule 1 and any products which contain a substance listed in the schedule with concentration limits higher than the limits set, as defined in section 1(11).
(ii) 'Corrosive product' does not include a substance or product contained in a battery subsection as stated in subsection 1(15).
(iii) It is a defence for a person charged with this offence under if they can prove that they took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid the commission of the offence (per section 1(2).
(iv) A defence in relation to remote sales can be found at section 2, whereby the seller, as a minimum have to prove that the conditions in subsections (6) to (9) are met.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant sold to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),, a person under the age of 18 years, a corrosive product, namely **(..SPECIFY CORROSIVE PRODUCT..).

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
